# mtncloud_integrations (Data Source)

Lists your integrations, including those made in the console. Integrations with outside tools, for example Git or Ansible. Their credentials are never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_integrations" "all" {}

output "integrations" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_integrations.all.integrations : x.id => { name = x.name, status = x.status } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return integrations whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `integrations` (Attributes List) The integrations, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `id` (Number) ID of the integration.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration.
- `status` (String) Status, for example `ok`.
- `type` (String) Integration type, or empty.
- `url` (String) URL, or empty.
